messages:
maria: Heads up — saw EU agg-hours undercount for 2025-11-02 00:00-03:00 UTC. Likely kafka spill to shard 12. Thinking precision-window recompute limited to affected event-times rather than full-day backfill to save quota.
aj: Strong +1 for precision-window. We should compute event-time bounds per partition and do shard-aware dedupe. Reuse existing replay tokens and set a rate cap.
sam: Fine with precision but console UX will show a weird progress bar since estimator assumes per-day runs. Can frontend show fractional hour progress with tooltip and 'precision run' badge?
oz: Implementation notes:
- add query param `precision=true` and `window_secs=10800` to reprocess API
- scheduler should prefer off-peak low-latency slots (02:00-05:00 UTC)
- enforce job tag `precision-recompute-eu-nov02` for billing attribution
Example API call:
```
POST /api/v1/reprocess
{
  "tenant": "eu-prod",
  "start_ts": 1709433600,
  "end_ts": 1709444400,
  "precision": true,
  "window_secs": 10800,
  "job_tag": "precision-recompute-eu-nov02"
}
```
replay-bot: scheduled rj-88011 for tenant=eu-prod window=[1709433600,1709444400] precision=true
anna-ux: I'll add a small UI tweak: when job.metadata.precision==true show 'window-level' progress, and an info tooltip explaining why counts may update mid-day. Minimal patch, can ship as feature flag.
product-ops: Heads-up — if this touches customer dashboards, we need a short status note for EU customers on freshness alerts. Maria can you draft? I'll review.
aj: Canary plan:
- run on single affected shard (shard=12)
- validate with logs via `tools/validate_replay --shard 12`
- check telemetry dashboard `telemetry/agg-hours` for latency and spike in errors
I'll take ownership of the canary.
maria: Thanks. Two questions: 1) do we let the replay deduct from tenant quota or bill centrally? 2) what's the SLA on the stagger (how quickly do we want to finish all shards)?
ops: Prefer central billing for precision runs under 1 hour to avoid tenant surprises. Stagger: 30m between shard jobs, abort on first 3 consecutive failures.
aj: Canary ran: shard=12 events_replayed=8,412 deduped=1 aggregates_delta=+0.28% validate script shows no dupes. CPU +6% on workers.
replay-bot: scheduled rj-88012 rj-88013 rj-88014 next=2025-11-03T02:30:00Z
maria: launching staggered rollout starting 02:30 UTC. Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/precision-recompute-eu-nov02
product-ops: draft sent. Will ping EU customers subscribed to freshness alerts after first wave completes.
sam: front-end flag rolled out in canary; UI shows 'precision' badge and window progress. No regressions.
maria: closing loop for now. Will paste job IDs and final validation in this thread. Thanks team.
